Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-05 step 1; TFA-94700 AC 5 · “Confirm no provider API key is present anywhere in client-side/browser code.”.

Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S01 Built web bundle of the UAT commit: no provider key or credential string anywhere

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And … (UAT OAT-05 step 1; TFA-94700 AC 5; TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1'); TFA-94423 AC 1)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The production web bundle of the UAT commit, from the deployed host (every JS, CSS, HTML file and any served .map) or built from that commit with the production env

When Search every file for key patterns: 'sk-' followed by 20 or more key characters (OpenAI, including sk-proj-), AKIA or ASIA followed by 16 upper-case characters (AWS key ID), 'aws_secret_access_key', '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----', '"private_key"', '.iam.gserviceaccount.com', 'AIza' (Google API key), the Deepgram 'Token …

Then No pattern matches. The only baked env values are VITE_CONVEX_URL, VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL, VITE_HIDE_HIPAA_BANNER and VITE_SHOW_ROUNDING_SHEET, plus the build constants __APP_VERSION__ and __APP_COMMIT__ and Vite's own MODE, DEV, PROD, SSR and BASE_URL. None of them is a credential.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 1 'no provider API key … anywhere in client-side/browser code', and Expected 'All keys server-side only'; TFA-94700 AC 5. Any match is a Fail, quoted with the file and offset; the value is masked in the evidence. A baked value outside the four VITE_ names and the expected build constants is reviewed and is a Fail if it is a credential. …
